author: cnippet.dev
name: cnippet-chart
description: A set of composable chart primitives built on Recharts, providing a themeable ChartContainer plus ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipContent, ChartLegend and ChartLegendContent. Colors are driven by a typed ChartConfig and exposed as CSS variables, so the same wrappers render bar, line, area, pie, radar, radial and composed charts with consistent styling in light and dark mode.
